visual_flags.finding: Published aerial wording is incorrect: image is elevated shoreline oblique photo.
Dr John Allan's 1934 future hazard zones are not a contemporary 1903 landslide chart.
Archive says 1903 photograph was taken before the slide.
Navy catalog says off Mare Island, but 'underway' cannot be established.
Aerial plus inset geographic map with yellow overlay, not unannotated view.
1904 stereo card, preserve stereoscopic pair and descriptive label.

rights_warning: Navy custody is not a blanket public-domain guarantee when private photographers or museums donated historical photographs. Canadian public-domain status is not automatically US clearance. CC BY-SA requires attribution and derivative rules.
replacement_plan: STAGING ONLY: collect verified guest HTTP/naturalWidth,currentSrc,resource bytes, image identity, rights/license and caption review; prefer catalog originals (NHHC, LOC, AGS or properly credited Commons), derive max960 width preserving aspect ratio without upscaling, retain access to zoomable originals for maps; manually reconcile per post and capture rollback hashes before any approved WordPress writes.

rows.live_alt: Engine 15 near the Hurst Building at the beginning of the Great Baltimore Fire on February 7, 1904.
rows.source_authority: Library of Congress, stereo 1s46043; William H. Rau (1904)
rows.rights_review: Photograph copyrighted in 1904 by William H. Rau; LOC says 'no known restrictions on publication', not a grant of copyright. Independent publication analysis before rehosting.
rows.provenance_and_identity_review: Catalog digital ID stereo 1s46043 matches final path 1s46043v; no binary proof.
rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Stereograph catalog title specifies Engine 15 deserted during collapse of Hurst Building at start of Feb 7 1904 fire; scan stereoscopic, not a single 2-D view.
rows.suggested_alt: Stereograph of Engine 15 deserted near the collapsing Hurst Building at the start of Baltimore's fire, February 7, 1904.
rows.other_notes: Avoid cropping out stereoscopic pairing or labels; verify whether source URL itself loads in guest browser.

rows.scene_and_visual_finding: Official Navy photograph shows Tang off Mare Island on Dec 2 1943; does NOT independently establish the submarine is underway.
rows.suggested_alt: USS Tang (SS-306) off Mare Island Navy Yard, California, December 2, 1943.
